metadata.title: Microsoft to Wind Down Renting of AI Cloud Capacity From Oracle: Report<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Microsoft Won’t Renew Deal for Renting AI Cloud Capacity From Oracle: Report
Shares of Oracle turned slightly higher Friday following a report that said Microsoft was bringing to an end an agreement to rent artificial-intelligence computing capacity from Oracle.
